title: microvia stacks: ignore preset dimensions that are out of range
message:
microvia stacks: ignore preset dimensions that are out of range

A preset's via size and hole size are read from the project file in
millimetres, and went straight to internal units with no check. A number
too large to fit came out as garbage.

A value that does not fit is now treated as no value at all. The board
defaults apply, the same as for a missing size.

Assisted-by: Claude Code

title: microvia stacks: build the stack on the via the drop actually placed
message:
microvia stacks: build the stack on the via the drop actually placed

A stack is built after the route finishes, because the board cannot be
touched while the router is running. So the drop has to find its via
again afterwards. It looked for one with the right net and layer span.
That is not enough to tell two vias apart. An ordinary microvia from the
same route could match, and was turned into a stack by mistake.

Now the drop remembers where its via landed. Only that via is expanded.

Assisted-by: Claude Code

title: Break group deserialization into a two-step process.
message:
Break group deserialization into a two-step process.

The first step only adds members to the group's m_deserializedItems
list.  They must be  added to the proper members list (m_items) by
FinalizeGroupDeserialization() once the group has passed all the
sanity checks and will be kept).  Otherwise we can end up with
dangling parentGroup pointers in the member items if the group
ends up being thrown away.

title: common: offer a passphrase for every encrypted SSH key format
message:
common: offer a passphrase for every encrypted SSH key format

The repository dialog greys out its passphrase field for a key that needs
no passphrase. It decided that by looking for the word ENCRYPTED on the
first line of the key file. Only a PKCS#8 key says so there. A classic
PEM key says it on the second line, and an OpenSSH key does not say it at
all.

The check now reads all three formats, and the dialog offers the field
whenever the key really is encrypted.

title: Keep mid-move edits in the move commit
message:
Keep mid-move edits in the move commit

Increment, unit and body style changes during a move pushed the move
commit or a separate one, so the undo step lost the rest of the move.
They now stage into the caller's commit and skip unplaced previews.

title: Run ERC on published connectivity
message:
Run ERC on published connectivity

Saved exclusions must still match after the switch, so we resolve them
against published witnesses and keep pathless fallbacks. Markers follow
legacy rules, one per screen driver rather than per sheet instance, and
each pin reports once against its nearest mismatch.
